title: a test member with six weeks of history, for testing freshness and learning

criteria.text: Two builder-flagged test accounts, Settled (history) and Newcomer (none), each with a PM-controlled address in private env
criteria.note: Builder accounts exist (`scripts/builders.ts`, #281) but no Settled or Newcomer persona [V grep].

criteria.text: Settled's home zip is in the Sacramento market, in a home town with unclaimed Pages
criteria.note: Not built; home towns exist since #695 [V].

criteria.text: `scripts/test-profile.ts` (dry run unless --apply, re-runnable) writes 6 interests, 15 follows, 10 RSVPs and 8 saves over 42 days on real Pages
Neither account's activity appears in any staff count, report, F109 report or Page number; a test proves it for every count and log
criteria.note: Builder exclusion exists in some places (`reports-queue.ts`, `waitlist-join.ts`, `is_builder()`) [V], but not for these accounts and no test covers every count.

criteria.text: `test-profile.ts --wipe` removes both accounts' history and no other account's content, other builders' included
criteria.note: `delete_builder_content()` wipes every builder's content, so a scoped wipe is new [V].

criteria.text: A phone checklist in the Issue says what to try and what to expect
criteria.note: #778 holds a one-line checklist item; the full checklist is written when the script lands [V].
